adjudication_protocol.agreement_rule: Both independent primary adjudicators must agree on SAME_ENTITY or DIFFERENT_ENTITY.
adjudication_protocol.disagreement_rule: ABSTAIN_DISAGREEMENT; no majority-forced tie break in V0.

candidate_blinding.rule: Adjudicators receive only external evidence packets. Any candidate output/reason or redacted Frontier identity signal in the adjudication view invalidates the packet.

closure.next_if_closed: implement only the bounded packet/redaction/adjudication validators; real adjudications remain external human work. A later quality-evaluation authority requires an immutable real label bundle.
required: 24 frozen protocol cases remain exact and executable
accepted gold controls prove candidate outputs/reasons and all frozen Frontier identity fields are blinded
evidence independence requires immutable candidate-disjoint evidence from at least two distinct origin groups
two distinct independent human adjudicators are required and cannot see peer labels before submission
disagreement/conflicting/insufficient evidence abstains rather than being forced
model-generated labels and mutable label bundles fail closed
challenge-only labels cannot enter headline metrics
zero evaluable labels cannot create a quality claim
one bounded hostile authority review closes under the standard repair policy

immutability.post_freeze_label_mutation: creates a new label-bundle identity; prior and new bundles may not be silently pooled

protocol_corpus.note: Synthetic hostile protocol cases only; they are not real-world ground-truth labels and cannot be scored as candidate quality evidence.

sampling_protocol.challenge_only_rule: Adversarial/challenge cases are diagnostic only and may not be pooled into headline quality metrics.
sampling_protocol.evaluation_random_rule: Selection must be frozen before candidate scoring for the sampled pair set; candidate predictions/reasons may not influence inclusion.
sampling_protocol.headline_metric_eligibility: Only immutable EVALUATION_RANDOM labels with final SAME_ENTITY or DIFFERENT_ENTITY gold status may be eligible in a later separately authorized quality evaluation.
sampling_protocol.zero_evaluable_labels: No quality PASS/FAIL or candidate-quality claim.

scientific_boundary.goal: Create a candidate-disjoint human adjudication protocol capable of producing future immutable SAME_ENTITY/DIFFERENT_ENTITY gold labels without exposing candidate outputs or consumed Frontier identity signals.
scientific_boundary.problem: Current entity candidate consumes provider-native identifiers, canonical targets, entity type/name, and explicit alias/rename evidence; labels derived from those same Frontier signals are circular.
